QuestInfo.name: Power of the Spirit of Darkness
QuestInfo.0: Following what the Empress said, go see #bChief Knight Eckhart#k before leaving Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: To use Eckhart's Vampire, you need a catalyst that will maximize the power of the Spirit of Darkness. Get it from #r#o4230201##k.
QuestInfo.2: You've learned Eckhart's Vampire skill. Until Lv. 90, use Nameless Darkness every 5 Levels to raise the Skill Level by 1.
